image_prompt.text: A chain of platforms wrapping up the inside of the tower, spaced within the jump limits
Platforms that vanish a moment after being stepped on
Trusses, ladders and tightropes on the harder floors
A reward area at the very top of the tower
Sixty-seven distinct stacked floors, each floor its own obstacle section

layout_placement.text: The end reward at the summit

notes: Sixty-seven stacked floors cannot be framed in a single top-down image - this is exactly the tall-tower case layout-intake warns about. The build should be decomposed into per-floor segments generated in sequence, and there is no field in this block to say so.
'slaps' may be a mechanic rather than just part of the name; it was treated as the title.
No checkpoints were requested, and tower obbies of this kind often deliberately omit them, so none were added.

open_questions.ask: No look was stated - should the tower read as bright and stylized, or something else?
How tall is each floor - 67 floors at normal height is well over a thousand studs, so should this be built and framed floor by floor?
Is there a reward at the top, and are there checkpoints between floors?

coverage_missing.ask: What should the tower look like?
How tall is a floor, and should the tower be generated floor by floor?
Checkpoints between floors, or a single fall back to the bottom?
Is 'slaps' a mechanic in the game, or just the tower's name?

answers.ask: No look was stated - should the tower read as bright and stylized, or something else?
answers.answer: Make it bright, colorful, and stylized like a classic Roblox obby tower.

answers.ask: How tall is each floor - 67 floors at normal height is well over a thousand studs, so should this be built and framed floor by floor?
answers.answer: Keep each floor compact and build/frame the tower floor by floor so all 67 stages are practical to play.

answers.ask: Is there a reward at the top, and are there checkpoints between floors?
answers.answer: Put a simple completion reward at the top and checkpoints between floors so players do not restart from the bottom.
